license.terms: The Copernicus Sentinel legal notice permits free, full and open use subject to lawful-use exceptions and requires source notice for distribution and a modified-data notice. Attribution included in README: Copernicus Sentinel data 2019; Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2019; Copernicus Sentinel data 2020; Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2020. This describes product origin; it does not certify mirror service terms.

sources.restoration: Use retained STAC item snapshots, asset URLs, ETags and range-session record; retrieve the same immutable COG objects from the listed public URLs and extract the source pixel windows using extract_sentinel2_windows.py. Recompute NPZ SHA-256 against source-window-receipts.json.
sources.limit: Whole COG objects were not downloaded or hashed; exact retained windows and hashes plus object ETags, Last-Modified and byte-range trace are available. Copernicus product openness does not certify mirror service terms. No ground-control registration accuracy is available.

sources.role: STAC catalog and public AWS COG access path for the Copernicus-derived Sentinel-2 L2A scene assets.

license.terms: Public catalog and S3 COG access; Sentinel product legal notice is recorded separately. No claim that the mirror itself grants additional reuse rights.

sources.restoration: Use retained Earth Search STAC snapshots and COG URLs/ETags. Run query_sentinel2_stac.py for refreshed discovery only; use frozen selected items for exact reproduction.
sources.limit: Earth Search describes its public API as best effort; retained query snapshots are the discovery record. Selected COG assets are derivative access copies.

methods.description: Retain and analyze exact native 20 m S2 L2A source windows on unmodified candidate polygon center masks and candidate-union∩source-contact masks. Average B03/B08 2×2 raw 10 m blocks, combine with B11 and SCL 20 m samples; calculate MNDWI/NDWI threshold sensitivity and same-center SCL6/positive-MNDWI concordance. Exclude no-data, defective, dark, cloud/shadow, cirrus and snow classes from clear indices. No geometry repair/reprojection/buffering and no bank or authority inference.
methods.software: Python 3.12.14; NumPy 2.3.5; Rasterio 1.4.3; GDAL 3.9.3; EPSG:32733/32734 native grids
methods.units: 20 m pixel-center sample counts; nonadditive across overlapping dates/tiles/masks; normalized index values

conclusions.text: Across 16 retained dated scenes, 20/21 original candidate masks have at least one same-center SCL6 and positive-MNDWI observation. One candidate has only three SCL6 samples and no concordant center; counts are observational, nonadditive, and not bank delineations.

Eight of ten candidate-contact overlap masks have at least one concordant water-like sample; one contact mask has no detected SCL6 or nonnegative MNDWI in these scenes, and one is sparse/nonconcordant. The masks are limited to candidate-union intersections and do not characterize full administrative polygons.
Absolute image-to-candidate registration, exact shoreline/bank position, historic/current channel position, boundary authority, processing cause and territorial assignment remain unresolved.
